justification: Both surfaces carry schematic linear motifs including crescent-shaped arcs and small repeated strokes, but this is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure whose body bears discs, rings, arcs and chevrons arranged around the torso, whereas B is a flat panel dominated by a manned boat with a row of crew strokes plus a profile quadruped — no boat, crew or animal appears in A, and no human body or disc in B.
